caption: Each lane spends the same 20 ms motion-to-photon budget, in milliseconds. Rendering takes 8 ms and the display scan 4 ms, so the network gets only 8 ms; a server 1000 km away needs 10 ms of light time, and the total becomes 22 ms, which is 2 ms over the budget.

spec.aria: Two timelines in milliseconds: the 20 ms budget splits into 8 ms render, 8 ms network and 4 ms scan, while a server 1000 km away needs 10 ms of network, giving 22 ms total and overshooting the budget.
